references.title: General Financial Rules (GFR 2017)
references.issuingBody: Ministry of Finance, Department of Expenditure, Government of India
references.relevance: Core legal backbone governing all public procurement, competitive bidding, GeM mandating, QCBS technical scoring, and contractual compliance.

references.title: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM) Architecture & Milestone Specifications
references.relevance: Technical interoperability benchmarks for patient health ID linkage and digital health record federation.

references.title: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP)
references.issuingBody: Ministry of Law and Justice / MeitY, Government of India
references.relevance: Strict statutory mandate governing personal health data processing, data fiduciaries, consent tracking, and localized processing.

references.title: Medical Device Rules (MDR 2017) & SaMD Guidance
references.issuingBody: Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation (CDSCO), Directorate General of Health Services
references.relevance: Statutory pre-qualification requirement; clinical AI algorithms functioning as diagnostic software must hold valid CDSCO licenses.

references.title: Strategy for AI in Healthcare for India (SAHI)
references.relevance: Strategic roadmap for scaling responsible healthcare AI across primary and secondary tiers of the Indian health system.

references.title: Ethics and Governance of Artificial Intelligence for Health
references.relevance: Global foundational guidance establishing ethical redlines, human oversight, and validation standards for health systems.

references.title: Evidence Standards Framework (ESF) for Digital Health Technologies & AI Buyer's Guide
references.issuingBody: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) / NHS England
references.relevance: Leading international procurement due-diligence framework adapted for tiered risk assessment.

references.title: ISO/IEC 42001:2023 - Artificial Intelligence Management System
references.relevance: Standardized auditing baseline for AI developer transparency, quality management, and continuous monitoring.
